summary: Tested the public order API and catalog checkout UI on desktop and mobile. Backend order creation/validation passed; catalog, filters, cart math, confirmation handoff, and mobile rendering were exercised.

integration_issues.issue: The delivery address field is visible but not required, so a delivery order can be sent with an empty address.

action_items: Make customer-address-input required when fulfillment is entrega and block WhatsApp submission until it is filled.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout uses window.open for WhatsApp and does not call POST /api/orders; this is acceptable only if persistence is intentionally not part of the customer flow.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed order through the public API for persistence/schema verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API root, order POST validation, 24-card catalog, category/search filters, cart quantity/total, WhatsApp confirmation state, and 390px overflow were covered. Retest delivery address validation and inspect final WhatsApp URL/message encoding.
rca of the issue: The address label is conditionally shown, but the input is rendered without the HTML required attribute and the submit handler only relies on name/phone required fields. As a result, the browser permits delivery submission with no address; conditionally apply required={form.fulfillment === 'entrega'} or validate before sendWhatsApp.
